passiveBonuses.desc: Units within 2 tiles of a Wall segment gain +2 armor.
Advancing through Dynasties (Tang, Song, Yuan, Ming) unlocks cumulative empire-wide bonuses.

age2.bonus: Defensive towers and walls deal +50% ranged damage. Fortified positions gain a free Tower garrison.
Siege units are produced 50% faster and move 15% faster. Clocktower acts as a Siege Workshop.

age3.bonus: Generates 2 gold per second. Nearby units fight with +10% attack speed.
All Wall segments gain +100% HP and towers connected to walls gain +2 range.

age4.bonus: All unit production costs reduced by 10%. Fallen units near Spirit Way generate Influence for the next Dynasty.
Periodically spawns a free Imperial Guard unit. Imperial Guard units within range gain +15% attack.

uniqueUnits.special: Charge attack deals 3x damage on first strike. Bonus damage to structures and siege.
Fires 2 bolts per attack. Slow move speed. Bonus damage to unarmored units.
Elite infantry spawned free by the Enclave of the Emperor. +20% damage during active Dynasty bonus.

uniqueTech.effect: Fire Lancer charge damage increased to 4x. Triggers a brief area fire on impact.
Dynasty bonuses persist for 60 seconds after transitioning to the next Dynasty instead of ending immediately.
All technology research speed increased by 20%. Researching a technology generates 50 gold.
